# dr_flac

`dr_flac.h` is [dr_flac](https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs) v0.13.4 by David Reid,
copied unchanged from the `flac-0.13.4` tag. It is available under your choice of
public domain or MIT No Attribution (see the end of the file).
CustomKeys uses it to decode FLAC samples without depending on JUCE.
